batting.name: ST Jayasuriya
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b D du Preez

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b D du Preez

batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c MV Boucher b D du Preez

batting.name: W Jaffer
batting.dismissal: c AM Nayar b Z Khan

balls.text: swings at length and gets a top edge that drops safely in front of mid-on

oh lord he's overstepped of all things! Its a good ball still, very full outside off stump, Nayar again tries that paddle shot but no bat, the ball rolls away down the track and he scampers off, wasn't a single in it and du Preez collects and has all the time to hit the stumps but misses, and then gives an extra run
good ball, right up there in the blockhole as Bravo comes down the track, just manages to get the toe end of the bat on it to cover and thats a great fifty up
makes room and gets a low full toss, which he swings and at inside-edges behind square leg, Bravo and Nayar hustle and get two
another heave but he inside-edges to Uthappa at midwicket
he's going down swinging! Nayar gets down on his knees and swings at a fuller ball outside off stump and gets a thick inside edge that beats fine leg, who is also up
another good shot from Nayar with mid-off in the circle, he comes out and drills the length ball straight down the ground and bisects the fielders

six more, with a misfield! Bravo makes room and advances, van der Merwe fires it wide, then Bravo loses a hand as he scoops the ball over mid-off, its up in the air for a long time and Uthappa settles under it at long-off but falls over the rope as he leaps back
shot! Bravo comes well down and swings the ball miles over midwicket

makes room, van der Merwe keeps it flat, Nayar drives to cover and sets off, just manging to make it but he was really gone for all money expect the bowler was in front of the stumps and tried to flick it back but wasn't in control
fired in, Bravo clears the leg and on-drives down the ground
fires it down the pads, Bravo backs away and clips over midwicket again
advances to a full toss and just manages to clear midwicket

finally he connects on that shot he's been trying for ages! Gets across and picks up the ball from outside off stump, paddle-slapping it ... okay, I just made that word up ... over short fine leg for four, superb placement because the man was up
backs himself to go over the top and does, slashing the fullish ball ala Suresh Raina over covers and it drops in no man's land so a couple more to Nayar
slides down the pads, he shuffles and turns it away for one

moves back again and this time punches the ball off the back foot, square on the off side, Uthappa runs across in the deep and collects, Bravo always wanted two and slides back in time to beat the throw
shot, Bravo! Backs away and gets his first four, creaming the ball hard and fast through extra cover
another step across to outside off and a paddle attempted, mistimes it and the ball rolls off the pads to short fine leg
starts to come down, van der Merwe sees him coming and fires it down leg stump but Bravo adjusts and manages to get wood on it for a couple past midwicket
flatter ball speared down leg stump, flicked in the air past mid-on
tosses it up well outside off, Nayar swings and misses again
takes a step back and drives inside-out over extra cover to Kumble
fuller and flatter, Nayar dances down and slogs to wide of mid-on
tossed up outside off, he covers the stumps and swings, messes it up
good ball, nipping back in from outside off stump, Nayar drives and gets an inside edge to square leg
Nayar gets across and turns the ball from just outside off stump to wide of midwicket, the fielder returns a good throw but Nayar is just back across the line on the second
comes forward and pokes at a good-length ball just starting to shape away, opens the face at the nth second and gets four down to third man
swings at one pitched up outside off and cannot make contact
shot and well stopped at extra cover, Bravo leans back and drives the ball very sweetly but the fielder dives and saves a couple runs
pitches on a length outside off and Bravo swings it hard to midwicket
quicker ball to end the over and Nayar again can't beat midwicket
lands it on a good length and Nayar plays it to midwicket
this time he connects, turning the ball from outside off past mid-on
slower ball, tossed up into the rough outside off stump and it spins in sharply, Nayar tries to turn it off his front pad but doesn't get the desired contact or timing
flatter ball and he drives over the covers in a hurry
and it works! van der Werwe tosses it up, Jayasuriya swings it with little footwork and is well held by Vinay Kumar running in and sliding forward from deep midwicket
again he makes room and PK knows it, pitches it up on middle and leg but Jayasuriya backs himself with the shot and swings it down to wide long-on
backs away to expose all three sticks and pushes the ball to cover
full on middle and off and on-driven with panache down to long-on
clever shot, using the pace to open the face and dab it to third man
length ball on the stumps and swung out to the square-leg sweeper
short of a length and Bravo awkwardly dabs it to the off side

shot man! Jayasuriya uses his feet and lofts the full ball over mid-off to raise his fifty, the second of the tournament this season and very crucial under the circumstances, he's had to lead the team through early difficulties
short ball, Bravo gets back and punches down past mid-off
quicker ball on off, he shuffles and turns it through midwicket
flighted up outside off stump, just, and Jayasuriya misses the sweep
flatter, shorter, wider and he cuts and gets beaten
slowly flighted up, Jayasuriya gets across this stumps and sweeps the fuller goodly and locates the gap behind square leg for a much needed boundary
another mistimed attempt to pull one from outside off stump, length isn't that short and he ends up dragging it across and down into the gap at midwicket
straighter ball and he flicks it in the air over square leg for one more
clears the front leg and swings a fuller ball from outside off stump, its not timed well but he manages the gap between midwicket and mid-on
back of a length outside off, he drives off the back foot and inside-edges

fuller outside off stump, Jayasuriya plants the leg forward and plays a swipe across the line, ball hits the front leg and rolls to the off side, Kohli runs in and collects and has a shy at the other end and just misses his mark
bit of room and he steers it down through backward point for one
too short and cut off the back foot through the covers
slower ball, flighted on a length, legspinner, defended back
spins away off a short length, cut out to sweeper and he jogs one
flatter ball, hint of drift, Bravo clips with an inside edge to leg
gently floated up on the stumps, Bravo uses his feet and flicks the ball through midwicket, calling for two immediately and old man Jayasuriya huffs and puffs
starts off with a full toss outside off, which is punched past extra cover, the throw from the deep hits the stumps and ricochets for an extra run
shorter in length and he punches well but straight to cover
good length, no room on offer, Bravo steers it to backward point
short of a length on the stumps, punched to Kumble at midwicket
much fuller on off stump, sweetly driven along the grass to mid-off
too short and dismissed for four, gentle pace and it sits up, so he pulls from outside off stump and goes over midwicket's head
good ball, full and going away from Jayasuriya, who comes onto the front foot and pushes the ball toward the gap between cover and point
more short stuff, more hopping to the leg side, this time he manages but on ball but its loosely pushed towards cover
slow bouncer beats Jayasuriya, who jumps away to the sixth stump in an attempt to slap the ball over point but he cannot connect, the ball doesn't carry to Boucher
uses his feet to make room and slaps a short and wide ball over the top and gets four to wide long-off, he's now looking to make something happen
short of a length again and this time he steers it down to third man
short of a length, he gets across and thinks about chipping it to the on side but the shot is not on and he adjusts to keep it back to Kallis down the track
slower ball, pitched up outside off, Bravo sashays forward and plays a punchy drive to cover, high elbow and all that good stuff
even better and thats the first six of the game in the eighth over, again a ball that was probably just a wee bit too short and in a flash Jayasuriya pulls it over midwicket
now some aggression from Jayasuriya, picking the fractionally shorter length and flat-batting the ball over mid-on's head, the ball makes the rope's acquaintance
a bit of flair in that shot, getting across and flicking the ball from off stump in the air over midwicket out to the man marshalling the boundary
beaten by the shape! Pitches off and leaves Bravo, pushing at it
tight stuff, back of a length just outside off and Bravo defends
a bit of room allows Jayasuriya to punch off the back foot to extra cover, where Kumble runs in from mid-off, slides, and lets the ball through his leg for an extra run
thats the right area, good length just outside off and Bravo defends
drops it shorter and he rides the bounce, steering to third man
good shot for one, Bravo getting across, after standing deep in his crease, and clipping the ball off off stump into the gap between square leg and midwicket
full on off stump and Bravo gets across to turn it to midwicket
pitches fuller on leg stump, he shuffles across dangerously and clips the ball away for a single out to the sweeper
gets across and drives too hard, cannot pierce the covers
much fuller, bringing Jayasuriya onto the front foot, he just pushes it down the ground and Kumble dives to cut it off at mid-off
angles away and he cuts but straight to Kohli at point
another short ball and this one surprises Jayasuriya, who gets into poor position to pull and the ball kisses glove but pops up and drops in front of cover and point
back of a length, just some subtle shape away as Bravo defends off the back foot and edges along the ground down toward short third man

a third for du Preez! What scenes in Johannesburg! This one isn't a good ball at all, short and going away but Duminy needlessly swings across and plays a terrible pull shot, getting a nick through to a gleeful Boucher
short of a length outside off and defended gently to backward point
short again outside off stump but this time Duminy rises and uses soft hands to get over the ball and drop it down safely wide of gully for a single to third man
bouncer outside off stump and Duminy sensibly leaves it be
nearly a wicket! Kallis pitches much shorter, Jayasuriya makes a meal of the pull as the ball sat up and took the shoulder of that, its up and drops in no man's land
short of a length outside off and defended off the back foot
pitches on leg and angles across, again watchfully patted back
back of a length on off stump and Jayasuriya watchfully defends
much fuller and Duminy plays this straight to mid-on
good ball, just holding back the length and Duminy decided to shoulder arms, the ball pitches in line but bounces too much before hitting Duminy very high

two in two, hello Dillon du Preez! He must think this IPL stuff is child's play, just pitching another ball up outside off stump and looking on as Rahane drives and gets an edge to Uthappa at first slip, its easily held and Bangalore are simply cock-a-hoop out in the middle

edged and taken! This is a start du Preez will remember forever! Just pitches it up fuller outside off stump, sucking Tendulkar into a loose drive away from the body and the thick outside edge is well pouched by Dravid at slip, moving to his right to make his presence felt on return
good ball again, right on the dime and Tendulkar defends
good first ball, just pitching back of a length and its played to point
holds back the length outside off, Tendulkar punches off the back foot toward mid-off and sets off and just makes it home as a tidy throw comes in quickly
now he veers onto the pads and thats twirled rather elegantly into the gap at square leg for four, another gem of a shot from Tendulkar, all wrists
better length on off stump and thats punched straight back to PK
another shot off the back foot, fuller and wider and he carves it to point
similar length but this time he plays it more square, right to point
top shot in any format of the game, that! Tendulkar just gets onto the toes and punches a length ball off the back foot and finds the gap at extra cover
gets room and back-cuts a short ball down to third man for one
walks across the stumps and turns it to short fine, where Jaffer dives
pitches on off stump, he turns it through midwicket and sprints hard
just back of a length and he chops it to Kohli at backward point
there's his specialty! Sees a short ball and slaps it over point for four
sharp bouncer, sits up and surprises Boucher, who cant stop it
off the mark first ball, getting the wrists into play as he shuffles and works the ball off the stumps around the corner for a single to get Mumbai on board
good over, a maiden to begin with and that too against Sanath! Pitches it up outside off stump to bring him forward and Jayasuriya pushes straight to cover
just back of a length, bit of movement away, pushed to cover
pitches on off, again comes in, this time he turns it to short fine leg
good ball, starts on middle and swings in, Jayasuriya thuds forward
oh that was close to hitting leg stump! Pitches just outside leg stump and gets some swing, Jayasuriya is late to connect and the ball clips his pads and almost rolls onto the base of leg
starts off with a good delivery, just pitching around leg stump and Jayasuriya pushes it back down the track to the bowler
and thats the end of that! Kallis just pushes the ball into the gap between cover and point to seal a fantastic win for Bangalore, their third on the trot
massive shot! Uthappa clears the leg and heaves this over midwicket
full and flat and hammered like a rocket down past mid-on
slogs the slower ball up into the air, its a miscue but somehow he picks the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on
creates some room and drives the ball inside-out past extra cover
fired in flat and Kallis drives it back to the bowler
uses his feet and drives the full toss down to long-on for two
pitched up and Kallis threads the gap at cover for one more
slower bouncer, well done, Kallis is early into the pull and beaten
walks right down to meet the ball on the full and drives to long-on
again he leans into a square drive out to the deep where Rahane dives, they run hard and get three more
slinging yorker down leg stump, Uthappa swings and misses and that one was going on to miss leg stump, as Malinga appeals the batsmen pinch a leg-bye
pitched up and Kallis plays another easy square drive for a single
flatter, fuller and hit with hard hands down wide of mid-on
slower ball and Kallis pushes off the front foot to cover
tosses it up and Uthappa makes room to bash this one but he doesn't time it and ends up dragging it with an inside edge to square leg
flighted wider and he drives hard down to long-off for one
slower ball, middle and off, and pushed back by Kallis
flat on the stumps and he drives inside-out past backward point

another little piece of finesse from Uthappa raises a fifty very, very overdue half-century for Bangalore! He again uses the pace and with soft hands glides the ball between gully and backward point and even third man cannot cut it off, well played Uthappa
comes back in off a length and Uthappa plays a good little shot, opening the face and running the ball down to third man
short of a length on off stump, Kallis goes back and dabs to cover
another attempted big hit but too much bottom hand, dribbles to mid-on
going, going, gone! Bravo tries a slower ball and Uthappa takes a step down and swings that off the length for a big six over midwicket
a chance goes down at backward point! Kallis square-drives with a flourish in the air but Duminy doesn't time his jump and fails to latch on to the catch
the pressure is showing on Mumbai now! Uthappa biffs another half-tracker down to long-off where the fielder makes a total mess of it to allow another four
effortless batting against some ordinary bowling raises the 100 for Bangalore, as Uthappa makes room and lifts this ball over mid-on for four more
gets back to drive but mistimes the shot wide of Tendulkar to mid-off
too short again and this time he flat-bats it to the sweeper out there
terrible bowling, a rank half-tracker which Uthappa pulls over midwicket
a bit too wide and he cuts it between the covers for a single
good length on off stump and coolly punched to long-on for a single
swings at one pitched up outside off stump and fails to connect
good comeback, right up there in the slot, a lovely yorker, well dug out
and thats fifty for Kallis, clipping a full ball off the pads out to deep midwicket, a very good innings chasing 150 and he needs to go the distance
slower ball, full outside off, pushed to extra cover where Zaheer dives well and he comes up in some pain, looks like its the bowling shoulder
short and wide and hammered off the back foot through cover
flighted gently, turns in and Kallis gently pushes to cover
slower ball slides into Uthappa, on-driving for a single
goes downtown this time, beating mid-on and Harbhajan cuts it off
slowly tossed up, turns back in a hint and Uthappa dabs it to gully
legspinner this time, slides on and Uthappa misses it
starts off with a stray ball way down leg stump, which is paddled very fine
quicker and straighter and Uthappa clips it toward midwicket
tries to get fancy, opening the face to steer it but no contact
too straight and thats nicely tucked around the corner for a couple
another tidy ball and Kallis drives straight wide of cover
slower ball on a length and Kallis punches to cover
superb shot and placement, leans into the half-volley and picks out extra cover, but Bravo covers a lot of ground in the deep and dives to save a couple
some tactic that, very very wide outside off stump
strays a bit too straight and he turns it to short fine leg
flights it outside off and it turns in sharply, Kallis cuts to point
expectedly, its flat on the pads and tucked away to square
see? Thats all you need to do, man! Shuffles in his crease and cuts the short ball very well into the gap behind backward point and gets four, very well played
takes two steps down, Harbhajan spots him coming and slows the pace, keeps it flat, so Uthappa pushes it back down the track
a premeditated reverse sweep but not played off well at all
hits a good length and he square drives right to the fielder
slides onto leg stump and Kallis cant find any timing
pushes to cover and sets off, struggling but does well to stretch and get across the line in time before Shah can collect and break the stumps
good shot, just leans into the wide ball and picks the gap at cover
a terrible ball, way down the pads and well taken by Shah
very wide, swinging away, Kallis chases and misses
straighter ball and he shuffles to on-drive it past midwicket
pitches it up outside off, Kallis meets it with a drive to cover
flat on the stumps and turned away toward square leg
outside off stump and guided down to short third man
flat still and he clips it away for a couple more
slower ball, flat on leg stump, Uthappa shuffles and turns it fine
flatter and much shorter and Uthappa gets into great position to paddle-pull the loose ball down and wide of fine leg for four to relieve the pressure
tossed up outside off, the doosra, Uthappa plays and misses
confusion! Kallis defends another good ball to the off side and sets off, then sees Uthappa shooing him back and has to turn and head but, just in time as Shah breaks the stumps
rolls the fingers over the seam, hits a good length, played to gully
pitched up on middle and leg, very tidy, Kallis plays to midwicket
comes onto the front foot and drives the ball through point
now its too wide and beats the attempted square drive
shout for lbw as the ball pitches outside off stump and nips back, but Uthappa got well forward to defend ... but its also the seventh dot ball he's faced
reaches out and drives on the rise between cover and point
and a maiden over! Excellent comeback after a bad first over and you have to say  thats down to the batsman he was bowling to, Uthappa, who just swung uselessly
another swing to a slightly slower ball, no connection and Uthappa loses the bottom hand on the bat, then he takes the ball on the shoulder
one-handed swing and a miss, real baseball style, reminded me of David Ortiz actually, but that cross-batted swing connects with nothing but air
good ball again, yorker on middle and leg and well played too

another good ball, slower ball, Uthappa defends well and then takes a few steps down as the ball rolls toward point, not sure where he's off to but Kallis certainly isn't risking that, Uthappa has to turn back and dive and makes it in time as Duminy nails a hit
good ball, right on off stump and Uthappa attentively defends
more wide stuff from Nayar and Kallis chops the ball to gully
changes the pace, hits a much better length, and Kallis pats it back
now a bottom edge for four, so its all going Bangalore's way! Shah is standing up, Nayar pitches it up, Kallis drives hard and gets a fortuitous four to fine leg
another excellent square-drive, just waiting a fraction and lacing the ball behind point and well wide of the fielder, so thats four more to Kallis
too wide and slapped between the covers, sweeper chases and stops it
pitches it up and Kallis drives off the front foot to cover
too straight and he tucks that off the pads, its a great way to use the pace, just played all along the ground through midwicket and even Zaheer cannot get there in time
good length ball and sensibly played by Uthappa, coming forward and gently defending it down behind backward point
short of a length and he flashes hard, running it down to third man
he's given him some tap! Malinga now offers room outside off stump and Kallis cracks that excellently, transferring the weight in a flash, and uppercutting over the infield for a flat six
better ball, slower and short of a length on off and Kallis defends
and welcome, says Kallis! Malinga veers too straight and Kallis superbly uses the pace, clipping it over deep backward square leg for half a dozen
simple catch to Nayar at square leg as Jaffer just turns the ball off his pads
another clip off the pads toward midwicket, Raje fumbles and allows an extra
fuller and shaping away, clipped hard to an alert Dhawan at mid-on
good ball, again on a length and slanting back in to Jaffer, who gets across and pushes at it with an inside edge toward square leg
again outside leg but going across and Jaffer tucks to midwicket
pitches outside leg stump and swings further so thats a wide
back of a length on middle and off and vigilantly played back
back of a length and crunched off the back foot but to cover
top shot that, just going over midwicket with power, picking off the pads
overpitched and square-driven in style but cant beat backward point
safest place to score your runs! Kallis throws the bat at more width and gets a thick French cut back past Shah to fine leg, where Zaheer does well to cut it off
now the fuller ball brings him onto the front foot, guiding to third man
smacked off the back foot, thats too wide and Jaffer goes past cover
poor ball, served up very full and wide and thats wide
holds back the length a fraction and Kallis drives hard to point
uppish but safe! Kallis now times this one with class, reaching out and driving the wide half-volley on the rise for four more
another Kallis specialty, forced to reach out and play the angling, seaming delivery with a thick outside edge past second slip by some distance for four
typical Kallis drive off the back foot, making sure to cover off stump, but playing away from his body and the result is an inside edge back onto the boot
shapes away off a fuller length and Kallis ... drum roll ... shoulders arms
thats a bad ball, though, full and going down leg stump, well taken by Shah
good ball to start off with, pitching on a good length to bring Kallis onto the front foot, pushing at it, but the ball shapes back and gets some extra lift to surprise him
